```rust
fn digitSum(s: String) -> isize {
    s.chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase())
        .map(|c| c as isize)
        .sum()
}
```

```rust
fn remove_vowels(text: String) -> String {
    text.chars()
        .filter(|c| !matches!(c, 'a' | 'e' | 'i' | 'o' | 'u' | 'A' | 'E' | 'I' | 'O' | 'U'))
        .collect()
}
```
